blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust applied to Pharmaceuticals & Biotech. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Pharma's frontier is acceleration under validation: discovery simulation, trial design, recruitment and pharmacovigilance all carry GxP duty. Companies that industrialize evidence pipelines compress the costly middle of the pipeline without compromising the audit.

items: Compound data and trial designs attract state-grade interest; labs run loose estates.
Target and molecule screening compute-bound; HPC and emerging compute underused.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation, Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation, Identity & Access Modernization from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Discovery screening, Protocol eligibility matching, Pharmacovigilance intake) on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — GxP/GCP validation among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Evidence once, audit anywhere: compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.
Never trust, always verify: zero-trust as an executable architecture, not a slide.
Detection that keeps pace: intelligence-driven SOC with the boring parts (tuning, coverage) done properly.
Classification-aware controls for compound/trial data (state-grade interest deterred)

At Healthcare & Life Sciences level this capability reads as: identity-centric access, device posture and segmentation across hospitals and clinics (ransomware blast radius contained in tabletop evidence). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
